findings.text: the figure does not walk to the glyph it Moves to (no presenter hop for the platform event in this build); Tidus stays among the party while the log says glyph 5. Disclosed in the lane handoff (section 10).

the advisor card on Yuna's menu at decision 10 forecasts the Keeper's next move as "Glyph 2 uses Glyph Mine before Auron can act": it names an idle Circle (Glyph 2) as the user of Glyph Mine; the user is the Spectral Keeper (the log: spectral-keeper:keeper-glyph-mine, seq 120). The same card shows "Next best move Life -> Auron" correctly.

after the shell breaks the boss strip still shows its two status icons (Shell and Protect) although DEF and MDEF read 1, so the HUD has no picture of the break beyond the banner; and the banner is headed by the name of whoever was acting in that frame ("Yuna", whose Darkness was on screen), not by Concherer or Paine

method.keys: every action is a real key press (Playwright keyboard) through the menus a player uses; the engine state, the battle log and the scene's ring objects are READ through window.__pyrefly (battleState, battleLog, targeting, the three.js scene); the seed is pinned by window.__pyrefly.setSeed before the first key (the labelled setup hook of the review harness); the only write to the engine is the single debug setup in debugSetups (the HP of Concherer after the break was read); the fight of the Wind Waker capture was played by autoBattle of the debug API (a motion reading)
method.seeds: the Keeper dry runs on the real engine predicted the live battles decision for decision (predictions.json, pred-keeper-*.txt); the live logs equal them event for event
method.lock: each browser job took D:/Tools/pyrefly-scratch/RIG-RECORD per job (tools/rig-record-lock.mjs); jobs killed by hand left their dead-pid record, replaced by the next taker
